About

The gap between
technology and outcomes
is execution.

Most enterprises are not short of technology. They are short of execution. Golam Mustafa has spent over two decades closing this gap — across Emami Agrotech, IBM, and Accenture — in manufacturing, FMCG, energy, and distribution environments where execution failure is expensive.

His work operates at the intersection of enterprise systems, business performance, and AI-led transformation. Trusted by CEO and CFO as a business leader with full P&L accountability — across revenue, margin, working capital, and risk.

"He is known for stepping into complex, underperforming programmes and stabilising them. Not by adding tools. By fixing execution."

Expertise

Where the work
actually happens

01

Enterprise Systems & SAP

SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, SAP IBP, BW/4HANA, Salesforce — integrated into a single execution layer connecting demand, supply, and cash across the enterprise.

02

AI Execution & Agentic AI

AI doesn't fix broken systems — it amplifies them. Deploying agentic AI across sales, collections, and supply chain that replaces retrospective reporting with proactive signals.

03

Transformation Recovery

Enters complex, failing programmes. Finds revenue leaks, control gaps, and execution failures. Rebuilds them into platforms that CEOs and CFOs depend on daily.

04

Revenue & Commercial Control

Unified primary and secondary sales across 2,000+ distributors. Pricing governance and scheme discipline enforced through systems — not manual oversight.

05

Finance & Working Capital

Collections, vendor payments, and reconciliation fully automated. Product-level P&L and margin visibility embedded daily. CFO holds a live liquidity position at all times.

06

IT Economics & Vendor Governance

AMS renegotiation at Board level. Technology managed as a business P&L. ₹3Cr+ annual savings delivered through structured vendor transition.
